text: RB FIN-101 [JVM / Cgroups]: Java container OOMKilled because -Xmx exceeded Kubernetes cgroup memory limit. Set -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=75.0 and align pod memory request=limit.
RB FIN-102 [CPU / Throttling]: Burstable GKE pod experiencing 65% CFS CPU throttling despite low average CPU. Increase CPU limit or remove CPU limit on latency-critical microservices.
RB FIN-103 [BigQuery / Slots]: Ad-hoc BI query scanned 18 TB unpartitioned table causing $112 spike. Enforce partition filter requirement and cap project slot reservations.
RB FIN-104 [Storage / Orphaned]: 48 unattached SSD Persistent Disks / EBS volumes accruing $1,900/mo waste. Snapshot volumes older than 14 days and delete unattached disks.
RB FIN-105 [GPU / IdlePool]: A100/L4 GPU node pool at 2% utilization for 12 hours outside training schedule. Scale node pool to minNodes=0 and enable cluster autoscaler scale-down.
RB FIN-106 [Security / BillingKey]: Billing export webhook leaked service token and prompt injection payload. Revoke compromised token immediately, redact secrets, and audit IAM billing permissions.
RB FIN-107 [Network / CrossAZ]: Cross-AZ Kafka replication traffic spiked egress charges by $450/day. Enable rack-aware consumer fetching (client.rack) to prefer local-zone brokers.
RB FIN-108 [Spot / Fallback]: Spot VM preemption rate exceeded 40% causing repeated batch job restarts. Diversify across 4 machine families and checkpoint intermediate state to GCS/S3.
RB FIN-109 [Observability / Logs]: Verbose DEBUG logging enabled in prod spiked Cloud Logging ingestion by 800 GB/day. Reset Spring Boot log level to INFO and apply log exclusion filter.
RB FIN-110 [Reservations / CUD]: Committed Use Discount (CUD) utilization dropped to 68% after service migration. Rebalance CUD commitments across active N2D/C3D instance families.
